business_problem: Lenovo’s enterprise customer onboarding and service deployment process depended on manual registration steps and handoffs that slowed activation and made churn risks harder to detect early.
solution_summary: Lenovo’s enterprise customer onboarding and service deployment process depended on manual registration steps and handoffs that slowed activation and made churn risks harder to detect early. Lenovo implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around ServiceNow AI Platform, Technology Provider Service Management, Workflow Data Fabric, and Service Bridge. Key components included ServiceNow AI Platform provides the common workflow and AI layer; Technology Provider Service Management runs service-provider onboarding and customer operations; Workflow Data Fabric connects operational data and automation context; Service Bridge connects service workflows to customer environments. Work enters as cases, requests, or automations before ServiceNow AI Platform, Technology Provider Service Management, Workflow Data Fabric, Service Bridge, and Strategic Portfolio Management routes or fulfills the work.

solution_components.name: ServiceNow AI Platform
solution_components.role: Acts as the common workflow and AI platform that unifies service data, automation, and user experiences.

solution_components.name: Technology Provider Service Management
solution_components.role: Runs service-provider processes such as onboarding, orders, and customer operations on one workflow backbone.

solution_components.name: Workflow Data Fabric
solution_components.role: Connects operational data across systems and powers automation with shared context.

solution_components.name: Service Bridge
solution_components.role: Connects Lenovo’s services with customer environments for shared workflows and faster onboarding.

solution_components.name: Strategic Portfolio Management
solution_components.role: Connects work demand, capacity, and portfolio priorities to execution.
